conclusions: Answer-grade parity: each repetition and arm has six supported-complete answers, two honest-partial answers and zero unsupported-or-incorrect answers. Both arms recover the distant gift-exchange exception and preserve upgrade/deadline continuity.

Corrected dispatch and multiline heading metadata removes the need for model reconstruction. Baseline reconstruction succeeds where actually performed. One baseline answer retains a truncated but non-material international section label; candidate labels are correct in both repetitions.

Explicit section incompleteness is visible in candidate retrieval responses and safely acknowledged. Baseline answers also acknowledge incomplete long sections; these trials do not establish an answer-accuracy or safety-rate uplift.

Observed retrieval increases from 45 calls and 66043 output bytes before to 52 calls and 86721 bytes after. These trials demonstrate no retrieval-call or output-byte savings. Runtime metadata and agent choices both contribute; causal attribution is not established.

recordedEvidence.result: One failing regression: malformed JSON escaped before a recorded attempt.
Four exercise tests pass, including malformed/double-encoded/null/array options recorded as ERROR attempts.

probeAccountingReview.reason: Current code converts invalid options to an audited error, logs it and counts it against the same budget. Budget-overrun attempts remain recorded and invalidate report compliance.

limitations: Two repetitions per arm on one synthetic corpus are limited evidence, not a statistical benchmark or proof of general answer improvement.

Concrete provider model identifier, settings and usage are unavailable. The recorded configuration is the same inherited host default with no overrides; provider details cannot be independently reconstructed.
Output bytes and calls are API transport measurements, not model tokens or monetary cost. No token or cost savings are claimed.
Read-only isolation was assessed from the supplied audited API traces. Native-host invocation, live ADO and other-platform behavior were not independently exercised by this reviewer.
Runtime and transport provenance was also verified by the parent assembler. This reviewer did not rerun model trials or package tests; recorded red/green test logs were inspected.
Published answer quality is partial for long exhaustive requests under the fixed budgets. Correctly declining to infer unseen conditions is safe behavior, not complete task coverage.
